info.title: Vistara reviewed gallery contract

x-vistara-catalog-schemas.description: RFC 9457 problem details with stable code and correlation extensions.
Opaque cursor, bounded limit, normalized search filters, and stable sorting.
Tenant-visible asset summary with safe metadata and application delivery paths.
Asset summary, allowlisted metadata summary, and album memberships.
Permission-gated normalized metadata without raw metadata blocks.
A bounded set of versioned asset targets and one allowlisted action.
Capture-date groups with import-date fallback and an opaque next cursor.
Bounded facet groups for the normalized asset query.
Mutable album metadata plus an ordered cursor page of members.
Flat tenant tag with aggregate version.
Managed share state without its bearer token or password material.
Intentionally limited public projection with no tenant or private metadata.
Trashed asset, retention deadline, holds, references, and reclaim estimate.
Revision-bound purge eligibility and impact preview requiring later confirmation.
Purge progress and per-item outcomes after separate human confirmation.
